name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.sum_weight_norm_sub_sq
statement:
theorem sum_weight_norm_sub_sq (z : ∀ i, F i) (x : E) :
    ∑ i, D.weight i * ‖D.map i x - z i‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2 + D.gaussianDefect z
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : (∑ i, D.weight i * (2 * inner ℝ (D.map i x) (z i))) =
      2 * inner ℝ x (D.synthesis z) := by
    calc
      _ = 2 * ∑ i, D.weight i * inner ℝ (z i) (D.map i x) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [real_inner_comm (D.map i x)]
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [← D.synthesis_inner, real_inner_comm (D.synthesis z)]
  simp only [norm_sub_sq_real, mul_add, mul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, D.sum_weight_norm_sq, hcross, gaussianDefect]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_logProduct
statement:
theorem gaussian_logProduct (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    D.logProduct (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x =
      gaussianLog (∑ i, D.weight i * a i) (D.synthesis z) t x -
        (4 * t)⁻¹ * D.gaussianDefect z
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : (∑ i, D.weight i * ((Module.finrank ℝ (F i) : ℝ) / 2 * Real.log t)) =
      (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2 * Real.log t := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ i, D.weight i * (Module.finrank ℝ (F i) : ℝ)) * (Real.log t / 2) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [D.dimension_identity]; ring
  have hquad : (∑ i, D.weight i * ((4 * t)⁻¹ * ‖D.map i x - z i‖ ^ 2)) =
      (4 * t)⁻¹ * ∑ i, D.weight i * ‖D.map i x - z i‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  simp only [logProduct, gaussianLogHeatFlow, gaussianLog, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hdim, hquad, D.sum_weight_norm_sub_sq]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_heatProduct
statement:

    D.heatProduct (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x =
      Real.exp ((∑ i, D.weight i * a i) - (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2 * Real.log t -
        (4 * t)⁻¹ * D.gaussianDefect z) * Real.exp (-(4 * t)⁻¹ * ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [heatProduct, D.gaussian_logProduct, gaussianLog, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_score
statement:
theorem gaussian_score (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    D.score (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x =
      -(2 * t)⁻¹ • (x - D.synthesis z)
proof:

  rw [show D.synthesis (fun i => D.map i x) = x from D.resolution_apply x]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_timeRate
statement:
theorem gaussian_timeRate (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    D.timeRate (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x =
      -(2 * t)⁻¹ * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) + (2 * t)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        (‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2 + D.gaussianDefect z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [timeRate, gaussianLogHeatFlow, gaussianHessian, gaussianScore,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id,
    map_smul, LinearMap.trace_id, smul_eq_mul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    mul_pow, sq_abs, neg_sq, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hs (f : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : (∑ i, D.weight i * (c * f i)) =
      c * ∑ i, D.weight i * f i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hs, hs, D.dimension_identity, D.sum_weight_norm_sub_sq]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.abs_quadratic_mul_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem abs_quadratic_mul_gaussian_le (A P R b r : ℝ) :
    |A * (P + R * r ^ 2) * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2)| ≤
      (|A| * (|P| + |R|)) * (1 + r ^ 2) * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : |P + R * r ^ 2| ≤ (|P| + |R|) * (1 + r ^ 2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ |P| + |R| * r ^ 2 := by
        have hr : |R * r ^ 2| = |R| * r ^ 2 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg r)]
        rw [← hr]
        exact abs_add_le P (R * r ^ 2)
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg P, abs_nonneg R, mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg P) (sq_nonneg r)]
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  calc
    _ ≤ (|A| * ((|P| + |R|) * (1 + r ^ 2))) * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (abs_nonneg A)) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = _ := by ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integrable_quadratic_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_quadratic_mul_gaussian (z : E) (A P R : ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => A * (P + R * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound (by fun_prop) z 2 (|A| * (|P| + |R|)) hb
  intro x
  exact abs_quadratic_mul_gaussian_le A P R b ‖x - z‖

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.exists_local_quadratic_gaussian_bound
statement:
theorem exists_local_quadratic_gaussian_bound
    (z : E) {A b P R : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hb : 0 < b t)
    (hA : ContinuousAt A t) (hbcont : ContinuousAt b t)
    (hP : ContinuousAt P t) (hR : ContinuousAt R t) :
    ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 t, V ⊆ Ioi 0 ∧ ∃ g : E → ℝ, Integrable g ∧
      ∀ s ∈ V, ∀ x,
        ‖A s * (P s + R s * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-b s * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)‖ ≤ g x
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => |A s| * (|P s| + |R s|)
  let C := M t + 1
  have hM : ContinuousAt M t := hA.abs.mul (hP.abs.add hR.abs)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp [C, M]; positivity
  have hMC : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, M s < C :=
    hM.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by dsimp [C]; linarith)
  have hbb : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, b t / 2 < b s :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hbcont (by linarith)
  let V := {s : ℝ | 0 < s ∧ M s < C ∧ b t / 2 < b s}
  have hV : V ∈ 𝓝 t := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht, hMC, hbb] with s hs hms hbs
    exact ⟨hs, hms, hbs⟩
  let g : E → ℝ := fun x => C * (1 + ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(b t / 2) * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)
  refine ⟨V, hV, (fun _ hs => hs.1), g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hg := integrable_quadratic_mul_gaussian z C 1 1 (half_pos hb)
    simpa only [one_mul] using hg
  · intro s hs x
    have hr : 0 ≤ 1 + ‖x - z‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have he : Real.exp (-b s * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (-(b t / 2) * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (neg_le_neg hs.2.2.le) (sq_nonneg _)
    calc
      _ ≤ M s * (1 + ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-b s * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) :=
        abs_quadratic_mul_gaussian_le (A s) (P s) (R s) (b s) ‖x - z‖
      _ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-b s * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs.2.1.le hr) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ ≤ g x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (mul_nonneg hC hr)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianLog_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem gaussianLog_hasFDerivAt (a : ℝ) (z : E) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (gaussianLog a z t) (innerSL ℝ (gaussianScore z t x)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) x).sub_const z).norm_sq).const_mul (4 * t)⁻¹).const_sub
    (a - (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2 * Real.log t)
  have he : -((4 * t)⁻¹ • (2 • (innerSL ℝ (x - z)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))) =
      innerSL ℝ (gaussianScore z t x) := by
    ext y
    simp only [gaussianScore, innerSL_apply_apply, real_inner_smul_left,
      neg_apply, smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← he]
  exact h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianScore_hasFDerivAt

theorem gaussianScore_hasFDerivAt (z : E) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :

proof:
:= by
  exact ((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const z).fun_const_smul _

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianLog_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem gaussianLog_hasDerivAt (a : ℝ) (z : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => gaussianLog a z s x)
      (LinearMap.trace ℝ E (gaussianHessian t).toLinearMap + ‖gaussianScore z t x‖ ^ 2) t
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := ((Real.hasDerivAt_log ht.ne').const_mul
    ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2)).const_sub a
  have hi := (((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul 4).inv (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ht.ne')).mul_const
    (‖x - z‖ ^ 2)
  have h := hlog.sub hi
  apply h.congr_deriv
  simp only [gaussianHessian, gaussianScore, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id, map_smul, LinearMap.trace_id, smul_eq_mul,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, id_eq]
  field_simp
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_hasFDerivAt {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (gaussianConvolution b f)
      (innerSL ℝ (gaussianConvolutionGradient b f x)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasFDerivAt_convolution_of_bounded_kernel (C := 1)
    (C' := 2*b*(1+1/(b/2))) hf (gaussianKernel_continuous b)
    ((innerSL ℝ).continuous.comp (gaussianKernelGradient_continuous b))
    (gaussianKernel_hasFDerivAt b)
    (fun y => by simpa only [gaussianKernel, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
      gaussianKernel_le_one hb.le y)
    (fun y => by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, innerSL_apply_norm] using
      gaussianKernelGradient_norm_le hb y) x
  have he : (∫ z, f z • innerSL ℝ (gaussianKernelGradient b (x-z))) =
      innerSL ℝ (gaussianConvolutionGradient b f x) := by
    simp_rw [← map_smul]
    exact (innerSL ℝ).integral_comp_comm (gaussianConvolutionGradient_integrand_integrable hf hb x)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h
  rw [he] at h
  exact h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_trace_derivative_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_trace_derivative_eq_zero {n : ℕ}
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ E)
    {V : E → E} {dV : E → E →L[ℝ] E}
    (hV : Integrable V)
    (hdV : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (b i) (dV x (b i))))
    (hd : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt V (dV x) x) :
    ∫ x, LinearMap.trace ℝ E (dV x).toLinearMap = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ b, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hdV i)]
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    let e : E ≃L[ℝ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :=
      b.repr.toContinuousLinearEquiv.trans (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ _)
    have he : MeasurePreserving e volume volume :=
      (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp _).comp b.measurePreserving_repr
    have hb : e.symm (Pi.single i 1) = b i := b.repr_symm_single i
    have hi := integral_partial_derivative_eq_zero e he i
      (f := fun x => inner ℝ (b i) (V x))
      (df := fun x => (innerSL ℝ (b i)).comp (dV x))
    suffices hz : ∫ x, ((innerSL ℝ (b i)).comp (dV x)) (e.symm (Pi.single i 1)) = 0 by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, hb] using hz
    apply hi
    · exact (innerSL ℝ (b i)).integrable_comp hV
    · simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, hb] using hdV i
    · intro x
      exact (innerSL ℝ (b i)).hasFDerivAt.comp x (hd x)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    Integrable (fun z => f z * Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have he : Continuous (fun z => Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) := by fun_prop
  apply hf.norm.mono' (hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mul he.aestronglyMeasurable)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    change ‖f z * Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)‖ ≤ ‖f z‖
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (Real.exp _), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have hk : Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
      apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hb.le) (sq_nonneg _)
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk (norm_nonneg (f z))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_integrable
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_integrable {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (gaussianConvolution b f)
proof:
:= by
  exact hf.integrable_convolution (L := ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (integrable_gaussian hb)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_continuous
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_continuous {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Continuous (gaussianConvolution b f)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : BddAbove (range fun x : E => ‖Real.exp (-b * ‖x‖ ^ 2)‖) := by
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change ‖Real.exp (-b * ‖x‖ ^ 2)‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hb.le) (sq_nonneg _)
  exact hbound.continuous_convolution_right_of_integrable
    (L := ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hf (by fun_prop)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_nonneg
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_nonneg {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) (b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    0 ≤ gaussianConvolution b f x
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg fun z => mul_nonneg (hf z) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_pos
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_pos {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (hmass : 0 < ∫ z, f z) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    0 < gaussianConvolution b f x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Function.support (fun z => f z * Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) = Function.support f := by
    ext z
    simp only [Function.mem_support, mul_ne_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨And.left, fun hz => ⟨hz, (Real.exp_pos _).ne'⟩⟩
  rw [gaussianConvolution, integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg
    (fun z => mul_nonneg (hf0 z) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable hf hb x), hs]
  exact (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg hf0 hf).mp hmass

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_gaussianConvolution
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianConvolution {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ x, gaussianConvolution b f x =
      (∫ z, f z) * (Real.pi / b) ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ x, (f ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ]
    (fun y : E => Real.exp (-b * ‖y‖ ^ 2))) x) = _
  rw [integral_convolution _ hf (integrable_gaussian hb)]
  change (∫ z, f z) * (∫ y : E, Real.exp (-b * ‖y‖ ^ 2)) = _
  rw [GaussianFourier.integral_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm hb]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_le_of_support_bound
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_le_of_support_bound {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) {R : ℝ} (hsupport : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R)

    gaussianConvolution b f x ≤
      (∫ z, f z) * (Real.exp (b * R ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(b / 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_mul_const]
  apply integral_mono (gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable hf hb x) (hf.mul_const _)
  intro z
  by_cases hz : f z = 0
  · simp only [hz, zero_mul, le_refl]
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussian_shift_le_uniform x z (hsupport z hz) hb.le) (hf0 z)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.lintegral_prod_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod_le (f : ∀ i, F i → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) :
    (∫⁻ x, ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i) ≤
      ∏ i, (∫⁻ y, f i y)^D.weight i
proof:
:= by
  let u := fun n x => ∏ i, (boundedTruncation (f i) n (D.map i x))^D.weight i
  have hmono (i : ι) (x : E) :
      Monotone (fun n => (boundedTruncation (f i) n (D.map i x))^D.weight i) :=
    fun _ _ h => ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (boundedTruncation_monotone (f i) _ h) (D.weight_nonneg i)
  have hpoint (x : E) : (∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i) = ⨆ n, u n x := by
    have he (i : ι) : (⨆ n, (boundedTruncation (f i) n (D.map i x))^D.weight i) =
        (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i := by
      rw [iSup_ennreal_rpow_of_monotone _ (boundedTruncation_monotone (f i) _) (D.weight_nonneg i),
        iSup_boundedTruncation]
    have h := prod_iSup_ennreal_of_monotone Finset.univ
      (fun i n => (boundedTruncation (f i) n (D.map i x))^D.weight i) (fun i => hmono i x)
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hmeas (n : ℕ) : Measurable (u n) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_fun_prod
    intro i _
    exact (ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const (y := D.weight i)).measurable.comp
      ((boundedTruncation_measurable (hf i) n).comp (D.map i).continuous.measurable)
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : (∫⁻ x, u n x) ≤ ∏ i, (∫⁻ y, f i y)^D.weight i := by
    have h := D.lintegral_prod_le_integrable
      (fun i => boundedTruncation_toReal_integrable (hf i) n)
      (fun i y => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (boundedTruncation_ne_top _ _ _)] at h
    apply h.trans
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod' fun i _ => ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow
      (lintegral_mono (boundedTruncation_le (f i) n)) (D.weight_nonneg i)
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ x, ⨆ n, u n x := lintegral_congr (fun x => hpoint x)
    _ = ⨆ n, ∫⁻ x, u n x := lintegral_iSup hmeas
      (fun m n h x => Finset.prod_le_prod' fun i _ => hmono i x h)
    _ ≤ _ := iSup_le hbound

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_compact_of_pos

proof:
:= by
  have hf (i : ι) : Integrable (f i) := (hfc i).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcompact i)
  choose C hC using fun i => (hcompact i).exists_bound_of_continuous (hfc i)
  have hs (i : ι) : ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ y, f i y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R := by
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := (hcompact i).isBounded.exists_norm_le
    exact ⟨R, fun y hy => hR y (subset_tsupport (f i) hy)⟩
  choose R hR using hs

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_continuous_compact
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_continuous_compact
    (hfc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hcompact : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (f i))
    (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i)
proof:
:= by
  have hf (i : ι) : Integrable (f i) := (hfc i).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcompact i)
  have hc : Continuous (fun e : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal
      (∏ i, ((∫ y, f i y)+e*(∫ y : F i, unitTent y))^D.weight i)) := by
    apply ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.comp
    apply continuous_finsetProd
    intro i _
    exact (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)).rpow_const
      (fun _ => Or.inr (D.weight_nonneg i))
  have hlim := (hc.continuousAt (x := (0 : ℝ))).tendsto.mono_left
    (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
  simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at hlim
  apply ge_of_tendsto hlim
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with e (he : 0 < e)
  let g := fun i => compactPerturbation (f i) e
  have hg0 (i : ι) (y : F i) : 0 ≤ g i y := (hf0 i y).trans (le_compactPerturbation _ he.le y)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (g i (D.map i x))^D.weight i) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro x
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 i _) _)
        (fun i _ => Real.rpow_le_rpow (hf0 i _) (le_compactPerturbation _ he.le _) (D.weight_nonneg i))
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (∫ y, g i y)^D.weight i) :=
      D.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_compact_of_pos
        (fun i => compactPerturbation_continuous (hfc i) e)
        (fun i => compactPerturbation_hasCompactSupport (hcompact i) e) hg0
        (fun i => integral_compactPerturbation_pos (hf i) (hf0 i) he)
    _ = _ := by simp only [g, integral_compactPerturbation (hf _)]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integrable_prod_continuous_compact
statement:

    (hfc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hcompact : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (f i))

    continuous_finsetProd _ fun i _ =>

  have h0 (x : E) : 0 ≤ ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 i _) _
  apply (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall h0)).mp

    (D.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_continuous_compact hfc hcompact hf0)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_prod_le_continuous_compact
statement:
theorem integral_prod_le_continuous_compact
    (hfc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hcompact : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (f i))
    (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) :
    (∫ x, ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i) ≤ ∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i
proof:

  have hi := D.integrable_prod_continuous_compact hfc hcompact hf0
  have h0 (x : E) : 0 ≤ ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 i _) _

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.lintegral_prod_le_continuous_compact
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod_le_continuous_compact
    (hfc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hcompact : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (f i))
    (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) :
    (∫⁻ x, ∏ i, (ENNReal.ofReal (f i (D.map i x)))^D.weight i) ≤
      ∏ i, (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (f i y))^D.weight i
proof:
:= by
  have hf (i : ι) : Integrable (f i) := (hfc i).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcompact i)
  have hp (x : E) : ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i) =
      ∏ i, (ENNReal.ofReal (f i (D.map i x)))^D.weight i := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 i _) _)]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ =>

  have hm : ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i) =

    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg (hf0 i)) _)]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (hf0 i)) (D.weight_nonneg i),
      ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hf i) (Eventually.of_forall (hf0 i))]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.even_pow_mul_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem even_pow_mul_gaussian_le (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (r ^ 2) ^ n * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) ≤
      ((n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) * Real.exp (-(b / 2) * r ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < b / 2 := half_pos hb
  have hf : 0 < (n.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_pos
  have hp := (div_le_iff₀ hf).mp
    (Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp ((b / 2) * r ^ 2) (mul_nonneg hc.le (sq_nonneg r)) n)
  rw [mul_pow] at hp
  have hp' : (r ^ 2) ^ n ≤ ((n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) *
      Real.exp ((b / 2) * r ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hc n)).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hp
  calc
    _ ≤ (((n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) * Real.exp ((b / 2) * r ^ 2)) *
        Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp' (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = _ := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integrable_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => Real.exp (-b * ‖x‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (GaussianFourier.integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add
    (V := E) (b := (b : ℂ)) (by simpa using hb) 0 0).re
  change Integrable (fun x : E => (Complex.exp (-(b : ℂ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + 0 * inner ℝ 0 x)).re) at h
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_neg,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_re] using h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integrable_even_norm_pow_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_even_norm_pow_mul_gaussian (n : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => (‖x‖ ^ 2) ^ n * Real.exp (-b * ‖x‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_gaussian (E := E) (half_pos hb)).const_mul
    ((n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n)).mono' (by fun_prop)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact even_pow_mul_gaussian_le ‖x‖ n hb

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integrable_norm_pow_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_pow_mul_gaussian (n : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x‖ ^ n * Real.exp (-b * ‖x‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_gaussian (E := E) hb).add
    (integrable_even_norm_pow_mul_gaussian (E := E) n hb)).mono' (by fun_prop)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have hp : ‖x‖ ^ n ≤ 1 + (‖x‖ ^ 2) ^ n := by
      rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 n, pow_mul]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖x‖ ^ n - 1)]
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul, one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (Real.exp_pos (-b * ‖x‖ ^ 2)).le

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound

theorem integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound
    {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] {f : E → G}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f) (z : E) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbound : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x - z‖ ^ n) * Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) :

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianKernelHessian_norm_le_kernel
statement:
theorem gaussianKernelHessian_norm_le_kernel {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (x : E) :
    ‖gaussianKernelHessian b x‖ ≤ (2*b + 4*b^2*‖x‖^2)*gaussianKernel b x
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 ≤ gaussianKernel b x := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(-2*b*gaussianKernel b x) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E‖ +
        ‖(4*b^2*gaussianKernel b x) • (innerSL ℝ x).smulRight x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (2*b*gaussianKernel b x)*1 + (4*b^2*gaussianKernel b x)*(‖x‖*‖x‖) := by
      simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb,
        abs_of_nonneg hk, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, innerSL_apply_norm]
      norm_num only [abs_neg, abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      gcongr
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
    _ = _ := by ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.norm_inv_smul_le_of_norm_le_mul

theorem norm_inv_smul_le_of_norm_le_mul {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G]
    [NormedSpace ℝ G] {u C : ℝ} {g : G} (hu : 0 < u) (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ C*u) :
    ‖u⁻¹ • g‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hu)]
  calc
    _ ≤ u⁻¹*(C*u) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (inv_nonneg.mpr hu.le)
    _ = C := by field_simp

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.logarithmicHessian_norm_le
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := norm_inv_smul_le_of_norm_le_mul hu hg
  have h2 := norm_inv_smul_le_of_norm_le_mul hu hH
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖u⁻¹ • H‖ + ‖(u⁻¹^2) • (innerSL ℝ g).smulRight g‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = ‖u⁻¹ • H‖ + ‖u⁻¹ • g‖^2 := by
      simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply,
        innerSL_apply_norm, abs_pow, mul_pow]
      ring
    _ ≤ K + C^2 := add_le_add h2 (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolutionGradient_norm_le_of_support_bound
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianConvolutionGradient, gaussianConvolution, ← integral_const_mul]
  apply norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
    ((gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable hf hb x).const_mul _)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    by_cases hz : f z = 0
    · simp only [hz, zero_smul, norm_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, le_refl]
    · have hd : ‖x-z‖ ≤ ‖x‖+R := (norm_sub_le x z).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (hsupport z hz))
      have hfz := hf0 z
      have hk : 0 ≤ gaussianKernel b (x-z) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf0 z), gaussianKernelGradient_norm_eq hb.le]
      calc
        _ ≤ f z * (2*b*(‖x‖+R)*gaussianKernel b (x-z)) := by
          gcongr
        _ = _ := by unfold gaussianKernel; ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolutionHessian_norm_le_of_support_bound
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianConvolutionHessian, gaussianConvolution, ← integral_const_mul]
  apply norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
    ((gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable hf hb x).const_mul _)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    by_cases hz : f z = 0
    · simp only [hz, zero_smul, norm_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, le_refl]
    · have hd : ‖x-z‖ ≤ ‖x‖+R := (norm_sub_le x z).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (hsupport z hz))
      have hfz := hf0 z
      have hk : 0 ≤ gaussianKernel b (x-z) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf0 z)]
      calc
        _ ≤ f z * ((2*b+4*b^2*‖x-z‖^2)*gaussianKernel b (x-z)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussianKernelHessian_norm_le_kernel hb.le _) (hf0 z)
        _ ≤ f z * ((2*b+4*b^2*(‖x‖+R)^2)*gaussianKernel b (x-z)) := by
          gcongr
        _ = _ := by unfold gaussianKernel; ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolutionGradient_norm_le_of_support_bound
proof:
:= by
  rw [heatConvolutionGradient, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (show 0 < heatNormalization (E := E) t from Real.exp_pos _)]
  calc
    _ ≤ heatNormalization (E := E) t *
        ((2*(4*t)⁻¹*(‖x‖+R))*gaussianConvolution (4*t)⁻¹ f x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussianConvolutionGradient_norm_le_of_support_bound
        hf hf0 hsupport (by positivity) x) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolutionHessian_norm_le_of_support_bound

      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussianConvolutionHessian_norm_le_of_support_bound

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_coordinate_derivative_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_derivative_eq_zero
    {f g : ℝ × X → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f (volume.prod μ)) (hg : Integrable g (volume.prod μ))
    (hderiv : ∀ y x, HasDerivAt (fun s => f (s, y)) (g (x, y)) x) :
    ∫ p, g p ∂(volume.prod μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_prod_symm g hg]
  have hz : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∫ x, g (x, y) = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hf.prod_left_ae, hg.prod_left_ae] with y hyf hyg
    exact integral_eq_zero_of_hasDerivAt_of_integrable (hderiv y) hyg hyf
  rw [integral_congr_ae hz, integral_zero]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_derivative_eq_zero_of_coordinates
statement:
theorem integral_derivative_eq_zero_of_coordinates
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] {ν : Measure Y}
    (e : Y ≃ᵐ ℝ × X) (he : MeasurePreserving e ν (volume.prod μ))
    {f g : Y → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) (hg : Integrable g ν)
    (hderiv : ∀ y x, HasDerivAt (fun s => f (e.symm (s, y))) (g (e.symm (x, y))) x) :
    ∫ p, g p ∂ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← he.symm.integral_comp']
  apply integral_coordinate_derivative_eq_zero (f := fun p => f (e.symm p))
  · exact (he.symm.integrable_comp_emb e.symm.measurableEmbedding).mpr hf
  · exact (he.symm.integrable_comp_emb e.symm.measurableEmbedding).mpr hg
  · exact hderiv

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.monotoneOn_integral_of_local_derivative
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_integral_of_local_derivative
    {u du : ℝ → X → ℝ} {I : Set ℝ} (hI : Convex ℝ I) (hIo : IsOpen I)
    (hint : ∀ t ∈ I, Integrable (u t) μ)
    (hdu : ∀ t ∈ I, AEStronglyMeasurable (du t) μ)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ I, ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun s => u s x) (du t x) t)
    (hdom : ∀ t ∈ I, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 t, V ⊆ I ∧ ∃ b : X → ℝ,
      Integrable b μ ∧ ∀ s ∈ V, ∀ x, ‖du s x‖ ≤ b x)
    (hpos : ∀ t ∈ I, 0 ≤ ∫ x, du t x ∂μ) :
    MonotoneOn (fun t => ∫ x, u t x ∂μ) I
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ∀ t ∈ I, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, u s x ∂μ) (∫ x, du t x ∂μ) t := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVI, b, hb, hbound⟩ := hdom t ht
    apply (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le hV
      (Filter.Eventually.mono (hIo.mem_nhds ht) (fun s hs => (hint s hs).aestronglyMeasurable))
      (hint t ht) (hdu t ht) _ hb _).2
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x s hs => hbound s hs x
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x s hs => hderiv s (hVI hs) x
  apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg hI
  · exact fun t ht => (hd t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro t ht
    exact (hd t (interior_subset ht)).hasDerivWithinAt
  · exact fun t ht => hpos t (interior_subset ht)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.sum_weight_inner_of_norm_sq
statement:
theorem sum_weight_inner_of_norm_sq
    (B : ∀ i, E →L[ℝ] F i) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∀ x, ∑ i, c i * ‖B i x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2) (x y : E) :
    ∑ i, c i * inner ℝ (B i x) (B i y) = inner ℝ x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := hframe (x + y)
  simp_rw [map_add, norm_add_sq_real, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h
  have hcross : (∑ i, c i * (2 * inner ℝ (B i x) (B i y))) =
      2 * ∑ i, c i * inner ℝ (B i x) (B i y) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hframe x, hframe y, hcross] at h
  linarith

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.resolution_of_norm_sq
statement:
theorem resolution_of_norm_sq
    (B : ∀ i, E →L[ℝ] F i) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∀ x, ∑ i, c i * ‖B i x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2) :
    ∑ i, c i • (B i).adjoint.comp (B i) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ
  intro y
  simpa only [sum_apply, smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, sum_inner,
    real_inner_smul_left, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left] using
    sum_weight_inner_of_norm_sq B c hframe x y

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_timeDerivative
statement:
theorem gaussian_timeDerivative (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    D.heatProduct (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x *
      D.timeRate (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x =
    D.gaussianAmplitude a z t *
      (-(2 * t)⁻¹ * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) + (2 * t)⁻¹ ^ 2 * D.gaussianDefect z +
        (2 * t)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2) *
      Real.exp (-(4 * t)⁻¹ * ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.gaussian_heatProduct, D.gaussian_timeRate, gaussianAmplitude]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_heatProduct_integrable
statement:
theorem gaussian_heatProduct_integrable (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

proof:
:= by

theorem gaussian_timeDerivative_integrable (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

      D.timeRate (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_score_norm
statement:
theorem gaussian_score_norm (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    ‖D.score (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x‖ =
      (2 * t)⁻¹ * ‖x - D.synthesis z‖
proof:
:= by

    abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (2 * t)⁻¹)]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_scoreDerivative_norm_le
statement:
theorem gaussian_scoreDerivative_norm_le (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    ‖D.scoreDerivative (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x‖ ≤ (2 * t)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.gaussian_scoreDerivative, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg,
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (2 * t)⁻¹)]
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := E)) (by positivity : 0 ≤ (2 * t)⁻¹)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.norm_fluxDerivative_le
statement:
theorem norm_fluxDerivative_le (U : ∀ i, LogHeatFlow (F i)) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    ‖D.fluxDerivative U t x‖ ≤ D.heatProduct U t x *
      (‖D.score U t x‖ ^ 2 + ‖D.scoreDerivative U t x‖)
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_add_le
    ((D.heatProduct U t x • innerSL ℝ (D.score U t x)).smulRight (D.score U t x))
    (D.heatProduct U t x • D.scoreDerivative U t x)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (D.heatProduct_pos U t x), innerSL_apply_norm] at h
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := h
    _ = _ := by ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_flux_integrable
statement:
theorem gaussian_flux_integrable (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable (D.flux (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t)
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (D.flux U t) :=
    (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (D.flux_hasFDerivAt U ht x).continuousAt).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound hm (D.synthesis z) 1
    (D.gaussianAmplitude a z t * (2 * t)⁻¹) (by positivity : 0 < (4 * t)⁻¹)
  intro x
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (show ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ≤ 1 + ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ by linarith)
    (show 0 ≤ D.gaussianAmplitude a z t * (2 * t)⁻¹ *
      Real.exp (-(4 * t)⁻¹ * ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2) by
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (D.gaussianAmplitude_pos a z t).le (by positivity)) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  simp only [flux, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (D.heatProduct_pos U t x)]
  rw [D.gaussian_score_norm a z ht, D.gaussian_heatProduct]
  simpa only [gaussianAmplitude, pow_one, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_fluxDerivative_continuous
statement:
theorem gaussian_fluxDerivative_continuous (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Continuous (D.fluxDerivative (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t)
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)
  have hQ : Continuous (D.heatProduct U t) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (D.heatProduct_hasFDerivAt U ht x).continuousAt
  have hS : Continuous (D.score U t) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (D.score_hasFDerivAt U ht x).continuousAt
  have hA : Continuous (D.scoreDerivative U t) := by
    change Continuous (fun x : E => D.scoreDerivative (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t x)
    simp_rw [D.gaussian_scoreDerivative]
    exact continuous_const
  have hT := ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ E E).continuous.comp
    (hQ.smul ((innerSL ℝ).continuous.comp hS))).clm_apply hS
  exact hT.add (hQ.smul hA)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_fluxDerivative_integrable
statement:
theorem gaussian_fluxDerivative_integrable (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable (D.fluxDerivative (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) t)
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)
  let k := (2 * t)⁻¹
  have hk : 0 ≤ k := by dsimp [k]; positivity
  apply integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound
    (D.gaussian_fluxDerivative_continuous a z ht).aestronglyMeasurable (D.synthesis z) 2
    (D.gaussianAmplitude a z t * (k ^ 2 + k)) (by positivity : 0 < (4 * t)⁻¹)
  intro x
  have hp : (k * ‖x - D.synthesis z‖) ^ 2 + k ≤
      (k ^ 2 + k) * (1 + ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg k, mul_nonneg hk (sq_nonneg ‖x - D.synthesis z‖)]
  calc
    _ ≤ D.heatProduct U t x * (‖D.score U t x‖ ^ 2 + ‖D.scoreDerivative U t x‖) :=
      D.norm_fluxDerivative_le U t x
    _ ≤ D.heatProduct U t x * ((k * ‖x - D.synthesis z‖) ^ 2 + k) := by
      rw [D.gaussian_score_norm a z ht]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl
        (D.gaussian_scoreDerivative_norm_le a z ht x)) (D.heatProduct_pos U t x).le
    _ ≤ D.heatProduct U t x * ((k ^ 2 + k) * (1 + ‖x - D.synthesis z‖ ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (D.heatProduct_pos U t x).le
    _ = _ := by rw [D.gaussian_heatProduct, gaussianAmplitude]; ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_heatIntegrability
statement:
theorem gaussian_heatIntegrability (a : ι → ℝ) (z : ∀ i, F i) :
    D.HeatIntegrability (fun i => gaussianLogHeatFlow (a i) (z i)) where
  product_integrable
proof:
:= fun _ ht => D.gaussian_heatProduct_integrable a z ht
  time_integrable := fun _ ht => D.gaussian_timeDerivative_integrable a z ht
  flux_integrable := fun _ ht => D.gaussian_flux_integrable a z ht
  fluxDerivative_integrable := fun _ ht => D.gaussian_fluxDerivative_integrable a z ht
  local_time_bound := by
    intro t ht
    have h4 : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => (4 * s)⁻¹) t := by fun_prop (disch := positivity)
    have hP : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => -(2 * s)⁻¹ * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) +
        (2 * s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * D.gaussianDefect z) t := by fun_prop (disch := positivity)
    have hR : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ => (2 * s)⁻¹ ^ 2) t := by fun_prop (disch := positivity)
    have h := exists_local_quadratic_gaussian_bound (D.synthesis z) ht
      (by positivity : 0 < (4 * t)⁻¹) (D.gaussianAmplitude_continuousAt a z ht) h4
      hP hR
    simpa only [D.gaussian_timeDerivative] using h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.gaussian_heat_integral_monotoneOn

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.norm_add_sq_le

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.norm_adjoint_apply

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.norm_map_apply_le
statement: theorem norm_map_apply_le (i : ι) (x : E) : ‖D.map i x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := real_inner_le_norm x ((D.map i).adjoint (D.map i x))

  by_cases hz : ‖D.map i x‖ = 0

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.norm_lift_le

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.growthCoefficient_nonneg
statement:
theorem growthCoefficient_nonneg {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) :
    0 ≤ D.growthCoefficient a
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (D.weight_nonneg i) (by positivity)) (ha i)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.weighted_growth_le
statement:
theorem weighted_growth_le {a v : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (r : ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≤ a i*(1+r^2)) :
    ∑ i, D.weight i*v i ≤ D.growthCoefficient a*(1+r^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [growthCoefficient, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  calc
    _ ≤ D.weight i * (a i*(1+r^2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv i) (D.weight_nonneg i)
    _ ≤ D.weight i * ((1+‖operatorTrace (E := F i)‖)*a i*(1+r^2)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (D.weight_nonneg i)
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (operatorTrace (E := F i)))
        (mul_nonneg (ha i) (show 0 ≤ 1+r^2 by positivity))]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.score_sq_le_of_growth
statement:
theorem score_sq_le_of_growth (t : ℝ) {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hg : ∀ i y, ‖(U i).gradient t y‖^2 ≤ a i*(1+‖y‖^2)) (x : E) :
    ‖D.score U t x‖^2 ≤ D.growthCoefficient a*(1+‖x‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.synthesis_norm_sq_le _).trans (D.weighted_growth_le ha ‖x‖ _)
  intro i
  apply (hg i (D.map i x)).trans
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (D.norm_map_apply_le i x) 2)) (ha i)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.scoreDerivative_le_of_growth
statement:
theorem scoreDerivative_le_of_growth (t : ℝ) {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hH : ∀ i y, ‖(U i).hessian t y‖ ≤ a i*(1+‖y‖^2)) (x : E) :
    ‖D.scoreDerivative U t x‖ ≤ D.growthCoefficient a*(1+‖x‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  have hl : ∑ i, ‖D.weight i • (D.map i).adjoint.comp (((U i).hessian t (D.map i x)).comp (D.map i))‖ ≤
      ∑ i, D.weight i*‖(U i).hessian t (D.map i x)‖ := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (D.weight_nonneg i)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.norm_lift_le i _) (D.weight_nonneg i)
  apply hl.trans (D.weighted_growth_le ha ‖x‖ _)
  intro i
  apply (hH i (D.map i x)).trans
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (D.norm_map_apply_le i x) 2)) (ha i)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.timeRate_le_of_growth
statement:
theorem timeRate_le_of_growth (t : ℝ) {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hg : ∀ i y, ‖(U i).gradient t y‖^2 ≤ a i*(1+‖y‖^2))
    (hH : ∀ i y, ‖(U i).hessian t y‖ ≤ a i*(1+‖y‖^2)) (x : E) :
    ‖D.timeRate U t x‖ ≤ D.growthCoefficient a*(1+‖x‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  rw [growthCoefficient, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (D.weight i), abs_of_nonneg (D.weight_nonneg i)]
  have hm : a i*(1+‖D.map i x‖^2) ≤ a i*(1+‖x‖^2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (D.norm_map_apply_le i x) 2)) (ha i)
  have hgrad := (hg i (D.map i x)).trans hm
  have hhess := (hH i (D.map i x)).trans hm
  calc
    _ ≤ D.weight i*(‖LinearMap.trace ℝ (F i) ((U i).hessian t (D.map i x)).toLinearMap‖ +
        ‖(U i).gradient t (D.map i x)‖^2) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (D.weight_nonneg i)
      exact norm_add_sq_le _ _
    _ ≤ D.weight i*(‖operatorTrace (E := F i)‖*(a i*(1+‖x‖^2)) + a i*(1+‖x‖^2)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (D.weight_nonneg i)
      exact add_le_add ((norm_trace_le _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhess
        (norm_nonneg (operatorTrace (E := F i))))) hgrad
    _ = _ := by ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_time_derivative_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_time_derivative_nonneg {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 ≤ ∫ x, D.heatProduct U t x * D.timeRate U t x
proof:
:= by
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
  have hi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (b i) (D.fluxDerivative U t x (b i))) := by
    intro i
    exact (innerSL ℝ (b i)).integrable_comp
      ((H.fluxDerivative_integrable t ht).apply_continuousLinearMap (b i))
  have hz := integral_trace_derivative_eq_zero b (H.flux_integrable t ht) hi
    (D.flux_hasFDerivAt U ht)
  have htr : Integrable (fun x => LinearMap.trace ℝ E (D.fluxDerivative U t x).toLinearMap) := by
    simp_rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ b, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)
  have hle := integral_mono htr (H.time_integrable t ht)
    (D.divergence_le_time_derivative U t)
  rwa [hz] at hle

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.heat_integral_monotoneOn
statement:
theorem heat_integral_monotoneOn :
    MonotoneOn (fun t => ∫ x, D.heatProduct U t x) (Ioi 0)

    H.product_integrable
    (fun t ht => (H.time_integrable t ht).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (fun t ht => D.heatProduct_hasDerivAt U ht)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.norm_pow_mul_gaussianKernel_le

theorem norm_pow_mul_gaussianKernel_le (n : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    ‖x‖ ^ n * gaussianKernel b x ≤ 1 + (n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  exact (pow_mul_gaussian_le ‖x‖ n hb).trans (by
    simpa only [mul_one, gaussianKernel] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (gaussianKernel_le_one (half_pos hb).le x) (by positivity))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianKernelGradient_norm_le
statement:
theorem gaussianKernelGradient_norm_le {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    ‖gaussianKernelGradient b x‖ ≤ 2 * b * (1 + 1 / (b / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_pow_mul_gaussianKernel_le 1 hb x
  simp only [pow_one, Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one] at h
  calc
    _ = (2 * b) * (‖x‖ * gaussianKernel b x) := by
      simp only [gaussianKernelGradient, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos hb, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), gaussianKernel]
      norm_num
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by positivity)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianKernelHessian_norm_le
statement:
theorem gaussianKernelHessian_norm_le {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    ‖gaussianKernelHessian b x‖ ≤
      2 * b + 4 * b ^ 2 * (1 + 2 / (b / 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := norm_pow_mul_gaussianKernel_le 2 hb x
  norm_num only [Nat.factorial, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_mul] at h2
  have hk : 0 ≤ gaussianKernel b x := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(-2 * b * gaussianKernel b x) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E‖ +
        ‖(4 * b ^ 2 * gaussianKernel b x) • (innerSL ℝ x).smulRight x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (2 * b * gaussianKernel b x) * 1 +
        (4 * b ^ 2 * gaussianKernel b x) * (‖x‖ * ‖x‖) := by
      simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hb,
        abs_of_nonneg hk, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, innerSL_apply_norm]
      norm_num only [abs_neg, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hb]
      gcongr
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
    _ = 2 * b * gaussianKernel b x + 4 * b ^ 2 * (‖x‖ ^ 2 * gaussianKernel b x) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (by simpa only [mul_one] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussianKernel_le_one hb.le x) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*b))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.trace_gaussianKernelHessian
statement:
theorem trace_gaussianKernelHessian (b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E (gaussianKernelHessian b x).toLinearMap =
      (-2 * b * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) + 4 * b ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * gaussianKernel b x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianKernelHessian, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_add,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_add, map_smul,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id, LinearMap.trace_id, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [show ((innerSL ℝ x).smulRight x).toLinearMap =
    (innerSL ℝ x).toLinearMap.smulRight x from rfl]
  rw [LinearMap.trace_smulRight, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_innerSL_apply,
    innerₛₗ_apply_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.pow_mul_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem pow_mul_gaussian_le (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    r ^ n * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) ≤
      (1 + (n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) * Real.exp (-(b / 2) * r ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : r ^ n ≤ 1 + (r ^ 2) ^ n := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 n, pow_mul]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r ^ n - 1)]
  have he : Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (-(b / 2) * r ^ 2) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + (r ^ 2) ^ n) * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) + (r ^ 2) ^ n * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(b / 2) * r ^ 2) +
        ((n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) * Real.exp (-(b / 2) * r ^ 2) :=
      add_le_add he (even_pow_mul_gaussian_le r n hb)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.half_norm_sq_sub_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem half_norm_sq_sub_norm_sq_le (x z : E) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2 - ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - z‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x - z‖ + ‖z‖ := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (x - z) z
  have hs : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖x - z‖ + ‖z‖) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg x) hn 2
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖x - z‖ - ‖z‖)]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussian_shift_le_uniform
statement:
theorem gaussian_shift_le_uniform (x z : E) {R b : ℝ} (hR : ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤
      Real.exp (b * R ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(b / 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hz : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hR 2
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (half_norm_sq_sub_norm_sq_le x z) hb
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz hb]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.norm_sub_pow_mul_gaussian_le_uniform
statement:
theorem norm_sub_pow_mul_gaussian_le_uniform (x z : E) (n : ℕ) {R b : ℝ}
    (hR : ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ‖x - z‖ ^ n * Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((1 + (n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) * Real.exp ((b / 2) * R ^ 2)) *
        Real.exp (-(b / 4) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + (n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) * Real.exp (-(b / 2) * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) :=
      pow_mul_gaussian_le _ n hb
    _ ≤ (1 + (n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) *
        (Real.exp ((b / 2) * R ^ 2) * Real.exp (-((b / 2) / 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussian_shift_le_uniform x z hR (half_pos hb).le) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_assoc]; congr 3; ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.exists_integrable_gaussian_majorant
statement:
theorem exists_integrable_gaussian_majorant (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ g : E → ℝ, Integrable g ∧ ∀ x z, ‖z‖ ≤ R →
      ‖x - z‖ ^ n * Real.exp (-b * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤ g x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => ((1 + (n.factorial : ℝ) / (b / 2) ^ n) * Real.exp ((b / 2) * R ^ 2)) *
    Real.exp (-(b / 4) * ‖x‖ ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (integrable_gaussian (E := E) (by positivity : 0 < b / 4)).const_mul _
  · exact fun x z hz => norm_sub_pow_mul_gaussian_le_uniform x z n hz hb

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.exists_nonneg_compact_approx
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_compact_approx {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g : E → ℝ, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) ∧
      Integrable g ∧ (∫ x, ‖f x-g x‖) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgc, herr, hgcont, hgi⟩ := hf.exists_hasCompactSupport_integral_sub_le hε
  refine ⟨fun x => |g x|, hgcont.abs, hgc.abs, fun x => abs_nonneg _, hgi.norm, ?_⟩
  have hpoint (x : E) : ‖f x-|g x|‖ ≤ ‖f x-g x‖ := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf0 x)] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le (f x) (g x)
  exact (integral_mono (hf.sub hgi.norm).norm (hf.sub hgi).norm hpoint).trans herr

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.exists_nonneg_compact_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_compact_approximation {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    ∃ g : ℕ → E → ℝ, (∀ n, Continuous (g n)) ∧ (∀ n, HasCompactSupport (g n)) ∧
      (∀ n x, 0 ≤ g n x) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x, Tendsto (fun n => g n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, g n x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x))
proof:
:= by
  have he (n : ℕ) : 0 < 1/((n : ℝ)+1) := by positivity
  choose g hgc hgcompact hg0 hgi herror using fun n => exists_nonneg_compact_approx hf hf0 (he n)
  have hb (n : ℕ) : (∫ x, ‖g n x-f x‖) ≤ 1/((n : ℝ)+1) := by
    simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using herror n
  have hL : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖g n x-f x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => integral_nonneg (fun x => norm_nonneg _)) hb
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hLp : Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (g n-f) 1) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hL
    simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] at h
    convert h using 1
    ext n
    rw [eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm,
      ← ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm ((hgi n).sub hf)]
    rfl
  have hmass : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, g n x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x)) := by
    apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
    apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
      (fun n => ?_) hL
    rw [← integral_sub (hgi n) hf]
    exact norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hae⟩ := (tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_eLpNorm one_ne_zero
    (fun n => (hgi n).aestronglyMeasurable) hf.aestronglyMeasurable hLp).exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  exact ⟨fun n => g (s n), fun n => hgc _, fun n => hgcompact _, fun n => hg0 _, hae,
    hmass.comp hs.tendsto_atTop⟩

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.le_of_positive_monotone_limits
statement:
theorem le_of_positive_monotone_limits {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hg : MonotoneOn g (Ioi 0))
    (hzero : Tendsto g (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 a))
    (hinfty : Tendsto g atTop (𝓝 b)) : a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ t, 0 < t → g t ≤ b := by
    intro t ht
    apply ge_of_tendsto hinfty
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop t] with s hs
    exact hg ht (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hs) hs
  apply le_of_tendsto hzero
  exact eventually_mem_nhdsWithin.mono fun t ht => hb t ht

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_swap

    gaussianConvolution b f x = ∫ z, f (x-z)*Real.exp (-b*‖z‖^2)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_sq_eq_integral
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_sq_eq_integral (f : E → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (x : E) :
    heatConvolution f (a^2) x =
      ∫ z, (heatNormalization (E := E) 1*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖z‖^2))*f (x-a • z)
proof:
:= by
  let G := fun z : E => f (x-z)*Real.exp (-(4*a^2)⁻¹*‖z‖^2)
  have hs := Measure.integral_comp_smul_of_nonneg (volume : Measure E) G a (hR := ha.le)
  rw [smul_eq_mul] at hs
  rw [heatConvolution, gaussianConvolution_swap, heatNormalization_scale ha, exp_neg_nat_mul_log ha]
  calc
    _ = heatNormalization (E := E) 1*(∫ z, G (a • z)) := by rw [hs]; ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
        have he := gaussian_exponent_scale ha z (0 : E)
        simp only [sub_zero, smul_zero] at he
        change heatNormalization (E := E) 1*(f (x-a • z)*Real.exp (-(4*a^2)⁻¹*‖a • z‖^2)) = _
        rw [he]
        ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.initialAverage_continuousAt_zero
statement:
theorem initialAverage_continuousAt_zero {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
    {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (x : E) :
    ContinuousAt (fun a : ℝ =>
      ∫ z, (heatNormalization (E := E) 1*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖z‖^2))*f (x-a • z)) 0
proof:
:= by
  let k := fun z : E => heatNormalization (E := E) 1*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖z‖^2)
  have hk : ∀ z, 0 < k z := fun z => mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hkc : Continuous k := by dsimp [k]; fun_prop
  apply continuousAt_of_dominated (bound := fun z => C*k z)
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun a => (hkc.mul (hf.comp (by fun_prop))).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun a => Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      change ‖k z*f (x-a • z)‖ ≤ C*k z
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (k z), abs_of_pos (hk z)]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound _) (hk z).le).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  · exact ((integrable_gaussian (E := E) (by norm_num : 0 < (1/4 : ℝ))).const_mul _).const_mul C
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      change ContinuousAt (fun a : ℝ => k z*f (x-a • z)) 0
      exact continuous_const.continuousAt.mul (hf.continuousAt.comp (by fun_prop))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_tendsto_sq_zero
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_tendsto_sq_zero {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
    {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (x : E) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => heatConvolution f (a^2) x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (initialAverage_continuousAt_zero hf hbound x).tendsto.mono_left
    (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
  simp only [zero_smul, sub_zero, integral_mul_const, integral_normalized_gaussian, one_mul] at h
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with a (ha : 0 < a)
  exact (heatConvolution_sq_eq_integral f ha x).symm

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_tendsto_zero {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
    {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (x : E) :
    Tendsto (fun t => heatConvolution f t x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Tendsto Real.sqrt (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    constructor
    · simpa only [Real.sqrt_zero] using
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt (x := (0 : ℝ))).tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t (ht : 0 < t)
      exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht
  have h := (heatConvolution_tendsto_sq_zero hf hbound x).comp hsqrt
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t (ht : 0 < t)
  change heatConvolution f ((Real.sqrt t)^2) x = _
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt ht.le]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.boundedTruncation_le
statement: theorem boundedTruncation_le (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) (x : E) : boundedTruncation f n x ≤ f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ)
  · simpa only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_mem hx] using min_le_left (f x) (n : ℝ≥0∞)
  · simp only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_le]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.boundedTruncation_le_nat
statement:
theorem boundedTruncation_le_nat (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    boundedTruncation f n x ≤ (n : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ)
  · simpa only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_mem hx] using min_le_right (f x) (n : ℝ≥0∞)
  · simp only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_le]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.boundedTruncation_ne_top
statement:
theorem boundedTruncation_ne_top (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    boundedTruncation f n x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) (boundedTruncation_le_nat f n x)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.boundedTruncation_monotone
statement:
theorem boundedTruncation_monotone (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (x : E) :
    Monotone (fun n => boundedTruncation f n x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro m n hmn
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (m : ℝ)
  · have hyn : x ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ) :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by exact_mod_cast hmn)) hx
    simp only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_mem hx, indicator_of_mem hyn]
    exact min_le_min_left _ (by exact_mod_cast hmn)
  · simp only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_le]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.boundedTruncation_tendsto
statement:
theorem boundedTruncation_tendsto (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (x : E) :
    Tendsto (fun n => boundedTruncation f n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop (𝓝 ⊤) := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.iSup_natCast] using tendsto_atTop_iSup
      (show Monotone (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ≥0∞)) from fun m n h => by
        change (m : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (n : ℝ≥0∞)
        exact_mod_cast h)
  have hmin : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => min (f x) (n : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop (𝓝 (f x)) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => f x) atTop (𝓝 (f x)) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [min_eq_left (show f x ≤ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) from le_top)] using hc.min hn
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge ‖x‖
  apply hmin.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
  have hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact hN.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  simp only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_mem hx]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.iSup_boundedTruncation
statement:
theorem iSup_boundedTruncation (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (x : E) :
    (⨆ n, boundedTruncation f n x) = f x
proof:
:=
  iSup_eq_of_tendsto (boundedTruncation_monotone f x) (boundedTruncation_tendsto f x)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.boundedTruncation_measurable
statement:
theorem boundedTruncation_measurable {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (boundedTruncation f n)
proof:
:=
  (hf.min measurable_const).indicator Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.boundedTruncation_toReal_integrable
statement:
theorem boundedTruncation_toReal_integrable {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x => (boundedTruncation f n x).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (∫⁻ x, boundedTruncation f n x) ≤
      (n : ℝ≥0∞)*volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (n : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (n : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ => (n : ℝ≥0∞)) x := by
        apply lintegral_mono
        intro x
        classical
        by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ)
        · simpa only [indicator_of_mem hx] using boundedTruncation_le_nat f n x
        · simp only [boundedTruncation, indicator_of_notMem hx, le_refl]
      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_indicator_const_le _ _
  apply integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top (boundedTruncation_measurable hf n).aemeasurable
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top
    (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) (n : ℝ)).measure_ne_top) hb

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.resolution_apply
statement:
theorem resolution_apply (x : E) :
    ∑ i, D.weight i • (D.map i).adjoint (D.map i x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] E => A x) D.resolution

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.sum_weight_inner
statement:
theorem sum_weight_inner (x y : E) :
    ∑ i, D.weight i * inner ℝ (D.map i x) (D.map i y) = inner ℝ x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun z : E => inner ℝ z y) (D.resolution_apply x)
  simpa only [sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left] using h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.sum_weight_norm_sq
statement:
theorem sum_weight_norm_sq (x : E) :
    ∑ i, D.weight i * ‖D.map i x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using D.sum_weight_inner x x

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.synthesis_inner
statement:
theorem synthesis_inner (v : ∀ i, F i) (x : E) :
    inner ℝ (D.synthesis v) x = ∑ i, D.weight i * inner ℝ (v i) (D.map i x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [synthesis, sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.defect_eq_sum_sq
statement:
theorem defect_eq_sum_sq (v : ∀ i, F i) :
    (∑ i, D.weight i * ‖v i‖ ^ 2) - ‖D.synthesis v‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, D.weight i * ‖v i - D.map i (D.synthesis v)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [norm_sub_sq_real, mul_add, mul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [D.sum_weight_norm_sq]
  have hcross : (∑ i, D.weight i * (2 * inner ℝ (v i) (D.map i (D.synthesis v)))) =
      2 * ‖D.synthesis v‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ = 2 * ∑ i, D.weight i * inner ℝ (v i) (D.map i (D.synthesis v)) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [← D.synthesis_inner, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [hcross]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.defect_nonneg
statement:
theorem defect_nonneg (v : ∀ i, F i) :
    0 ≤ (∑ i, D.weight i * ‖v i‖ ^ 2) - ‖D.synthesis v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.defect_eq_sum_sq]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (D.weight_nonneg i) (sq_nonneg _)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.synthesis_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem synthesis_norm_sq_le (v : ∀ i, F i) :
    ‖D.synthesis v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, D.weight i * ‖v i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sub_nonneg.mp (D.defect_nonneg v)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.coisometry_apply
statement:
theorem coisometry_apply (i : ι) (y : F i) :
    D.map i ((D.map i).adjoint y) = y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg (fun A : F i →L[ℝ] F i => A y) (D.coisometry i)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.adjoint_norm_sq
statement: theorem adjoint_norm_sq (i : ι) (y : F i) : ‖(D.map i).adjoint y‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left,
    D.coisometry_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.map_surjective
statement: theorem map_surjective (i : ι) : Function.Surjective (D.map i)
proof:
:=
  fun y => ⟨(D.map i).adjoint y, D.coisometry_apply i y⟩

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_normalized_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_normalized_gaussian :
    (∫ x : E, heatNormalization (E := E) 1 * Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_const_mul, GaussianFourier.integral_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm (by norm_num : 0 < (1/4 : ℝ))]
  rw [show Real.pi / (1/4 : ℝ) = 4*Real.pi by ring,
    Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 4*Real.pi), heatNormalization]
  simp only [mul_one, ← Real.exp_add]
  rw [show -(↑(Module.finrank ℝ E) / 2) * Real.log (4*Real.pi) +
    Real.log (4*Real.pi) * (↑(Module.finrank ℝ E) / 2) = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.sum_weight_affine_quadratic
statement:
theorem sum_weight_affine_quadratic (a : ι → ℝ) (k b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (∑ i, D.weight i*(a i+k*(Module.finrank ℝ (F i) : ℝ)-b*‖D.map i x‖^2)) =
      (∑ i, D.weight i*a i)+k*(Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)-b*‖x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (∑ i, D.weight i*a i)+k*(∑ i, D.weight i*(Module.finrank ℝ (F i) : ℝ))-
        b*(∑ i, D.weight i*‖D.map i x‖^2) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [D.dimension_identity, D.sum_weight_norm_sq]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.rescaledProduct_continuous
statement:
theorem rescaledProduct_continuous :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => D.rescaledProduct f p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.continuous_exp.comp
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  apply continuous_const.mul
  have hu : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => rescaledHeat (f i) p.1 (D.map i p.2)) :=
    (rescaledHeat_continuous (hf i)).comp (continuous_fst.prodMk ((D.map i).continuous.comp continuous_snd))
  exact hu.log (fun p => (rescaledHeat_pos (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i) p.1 _).ne')

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.rescaledProduct_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [convolutionAmplitude, ← Real.exp_add]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, D.weight i*(convolutionLogAmplitude (f i) (R i) 1-(1/8 : ℝ)*‖D.map i x‖^2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (rescaledHeat_log_le (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i) (hsupport i) he _) (D.weight_nonneg i)
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_mul] using
        D.sum_weight_affine_quadratic (fun i => convolutionLogAmplitude (f i) (R i) 1) 0 (1/8) x

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_rescaledProduct_continuousAt_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hc := D.rescaledProduct_continuous hf hf0 hmass
  have he : ∀ᶠ e : ℝ in 𝓝 0, |e| < 1 :=
    ContinuousAt.eventually_lt continuous_abs.continuousAt continuous_const.continuousAt (by norm_num)
  apply continuousAt_of_dominated
    (bound := fun x : E => D.convolutionAmplitude f R 1*Real.exp (-(1/8 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2))
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun e =>
      (hc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [he] with e he
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (show 0 < D.rescaledProduct f e x from Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact D.rescaledProduct_le hf hf0 hmass hsupport he.le x
  · exact (integrable_gaussian (E := E) (by norm_num : 0 < (1/8 : ℝ))).const_mul _
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => (hc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).continuousAt

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.rescaledProduct_zero
statement:
theorem rescaledProduct_zero (x : E) :
    D.rescaledProduct f 0 x = Real.exp (∑ i, D.weight i*Real.log (∫ z, f i z))*
      (heatNormalization (E := E) 1*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rescaledProduct, heatNormalization, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
  simp only [mul_one, rescaledHeat_log_zero (hmass _)]
  apply congrArg Real.exp
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, D.weight i*(Real.log (∫ z, f i z)+
        (-Real.log (4*Real.pi)/2)*(Module.finrank ℝ (F i) : ℝ)-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖D.map i x‖^2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [D.sum_weight_affine_quadratic]; ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_rescaledProduct_zero
statement:
theorem integral_rescaledProduct_zero :
    (∫ x, D.rescaledProduct f 0 x) = ∏ i, (∫ z, f i z)^D.weight i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [D.rescaledProduct_zero hmass]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_normalized_gaussian, mul_one, Real.exp_sum]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (hmass i)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.tendsto_integral_rescaledProduct_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_rescaledProduct_zero {R : ι → ℝ}
    (hsupport : ∀ i z, f i z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R i) :
    Tendsto (fun e => ∫ x, D.rescaledProduct f e x) (𝓝 0)
      (𝓝 (∏ i, (∫ z, f i z)^D.weight i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.integral_rescaledProduct_continuousAt_zero hf hf0 hmass hsupport
  rw [ContinuousAt, D.integral_rescaledProduct_zero hmass] at h
  exact h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussian_exponent_scale
statement:
theorem gaussian_exponent_scale {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (x z : E) :
    -(4*a^2)⁻¹*‖a • x-z‖^2 = -(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x-a⁻¹ • z‖^2
proof:
:= by
  have he : a • x-z = a • (x-a⁻¹ • z) := by
    rw [smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha.ne', one_smul]
  rw [he, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  field_simp

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianConvolution_scale
statement:
theorem gaussianConvolution_scale (f : E → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (x : E) :
    gaussianConvolution (4*a^2)⁻¹ f (a • x) = rescaledConvolution f a⁻¹ x
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    change f z*Real.exp (-(4*a^2)⁻¹*‖a • x-z‖^2) = _
    rw [gaussian_exponent_scale ha]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatNormalization_scale
statement:
theorem heatNormalization_scale {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    heatNormalization (E := E) (a^2) =
      Real.exp (-(Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)*Real.log a)*heatNormalization (E := E) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [heatNormalization, heatNormalization, mul_one,
    Real.log_mul (by positivity : 4*Real.pi ≠ 0) (pow_ne_zero 2 ha.ne'), Real.log_pow,
    ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_scale
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_scale (f : E → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (x : E) :
    heatConvolution f (a^2) (a • x) =
      Real.exp (-(Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)*Real.log a)*rescaledHeat f a⁻¹ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [heatConvolution, gaussianConvolution_scale f ha, heatNormalization_scale ha, rescaledHeat, mul_assoc]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.exp_neg_nat_mul_log
statement:
theorem exp_neg_nat_mul_log {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (-(n : ℝ)*Real.log a) = (a^n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mul, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log ha]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.heatProduct_convolution_scale
statement:
theorem heatProduct_convolution_scale {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (x : E) :
    D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) (a^2) (a • x) =
      (a^Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹*D.rescaledProduct f a⁻¹ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exp_neg_nat_mul_log ha, rescaledProduct, ← Real.exp_add]
  apply congrArg Real.exp
  change (∑ i, D.weight i*Real.log (heatConvolution (f i) (a^2) (D.map i (a • x)))) = _
  simp only [map_smul, heatConvolution_scale _ ha,
    Real.log_mul (Real.exp_pos _).ne' (rescaledHeat_pos (hf _) (hf0 _) (hmass _) a⁻¹ _).ne',
    Real.log_exp]
  calc
    _ = -(Real.log a)*(∑ i, D.weight i*(Module.finrank ℝ (F i) : ℝ))+
        ∑ i, D.weight i*Real.log (rescaledHeat (f i) a⁻¹ (D.map i x)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [D.dimension_identity]; ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_heatProduct_eq_rescaled
statement:
theorem integral_heatProduct_eq_rescaled {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ x, D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) (a^2) x) =
      ∫ x, D.rescaledProduct f a⁻¹ x
proof:
:= by
  let Q := D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) (a^2)
  have hs := Measure.integral_comp_smul_of_nonneg (volume : Measure E) Q a (hR := ha.le)
  have hp : (∫ x, Q (a • x)) = (a^Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹*(∫ x, D.rescaledProduct f a⁻¹ x) := by
    change (∫ x, D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) (a^2) (a • x)) = _
    simp_rw [D.heatProduct_convolution_scale hf hf0 hmass ha]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [hp, smul_eq_mul] at hs
  exact (mul_left_cancel₀ (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ ha.ne')) hs).symm

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_prod_heatConvolution_eq_rescaled
statement:
theorem integral_prod_heatConvolution_eq_rescaled {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ x, ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) (a^2) (D.map i x))^D.weight i) =
      ∫ x, D.rescaledProduct f a⁻¹ x
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.integral_heatProduct_eq_rescaled hf hf0 hmass ha
  simp_rw [D.heatProduct_convolution_eq_prod hf hf0 hmass (sq_pos_of_pos ha)] at h
  exact h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.heatProduct_convolution_eq_prod
statement:
theorem heatProduct_convolution_eq_prod {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) t x =
      ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) t (D.map i x)) ^ D.weight i
proof:
:= by
  rw [heatProduct, logProduct, Real.exp_sum]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change Real.exp (D.weight i*Real.log (heatConvolution (f i) t (D.map i x))) = _
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (heatConvolution_pos (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i) ht _)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_prod_heatConvolution_monotoneOn
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht s hs hts
  have h := D.convolution_heat_integral_monotoneOn hf hf0 hmass hsupport ht hs hts
  have he (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
      (fun x => D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) r x) =
        (fun x => ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) r (D.map i x)) ^ D.weight i) :=
    funext (D.heatProduct_convolution_eq_prod hf hf0 hmass hr)
  change (∫ x, D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) t x) ≤
    (∫ x, D.heatProduct (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) s x) at h
  rw [he t ht, he s hs] at h
  exact h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.trace_lift
statement:
theorem trace_lift (i : ι) (A : F i →L[ℝ] F i) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E ((D.map i).adjoint.comp (A.comp (D.map i))).toLinearMap =

proof:

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.trace_adjoint_comp

theorem trace_adjoint_comp (i : ι) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E ((D.map i).adjoint.comp (D.map i)).toLinearMap =

proof:
