name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.dimension_identity
statement:
theorem dimension_identity :
    ∑ i, D.weight i * (Module.finrank ℝ (F i) : ℝ) = (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] E => LinearMap.trace ℝ E A.toLinearMap) D.resolution
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_sum, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul,
    map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, D.trace_adjoint_comp,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id, LinearMap.trace_id] using h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.trace_integral_operator
statement:
theorem trace_integral_operator {A : E → E →L[ℝ] E} (hA : Integrable A) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E (∫ z, A z).toLinearMap =
      ∫ z, LinearMap.trace ℝ E (A z).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
  have hi (i) : Integrable (fun z => inner ℝ (b i) (A z (b i))) :=
    (innerSL ℝ (b i)).integrable_comp (hA.apply_continuousLinearMap (b i))
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ b]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ z, inner ℝ (b i) (A z (b i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      change inner ℝ (b i) ((∫ z, A z) (b i)) = _
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hA]
      exact ((innerSL ℝ (b i)).integral_comp_comm (hA.apply_continuousLinearMap (b i))).symm
    _ = ∫ z, ∑ i, inner ℝ (b i) (A z (b i)) :=
      (integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)).symm
    _ = _ := integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe] using (LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner (A z).toLinearMap b).symm)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.trace_gaussianConvolutionHessian
statement:
theorem trace_gaussianConvolutionHessian {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E (gaussianConvolutionHessian b f x).toLinearMap =
      (-2 * b * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)) * gaussianConvolution b f x -
        4 * b ^ 2 * gaussianConvolutionWidthDerivative b f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianConvolutionHessian, trace_integral_operator
    (gaussianConvolutionHessian_integrand_integrable hf hb x)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    trace_gaussianKernelHessian]
  have he : (fun z => f z *
      ((-2*b*(Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) + 4*b^2*‖x-z‖^2) * gaussianKernel b (x-z))) =
      (fun z => (-2*b*(Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)) * (f z * gaussianKernel b (x-z)) -
        (4*b^2) * (f z * (-‖x-z‖^2 * gaussianKernel b (x-z)))) := by
    funext z
    ring
  have hki : Integrable (fun z => f z * gaussianKernel b (x-z)) :=
    gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable hf hb x
  rw [he, integral_sub (hki.const_mul _)
    ((gaussianConvolutionWidthDerivative_integrand_integrable hf hb x).const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rfl

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatNormalization_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem heatNormalization_hasDerivAt {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    HasDerivAt (heatNormalization (E := E))
      (heatNormalization (E := E) t * (-((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)/2) / t)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 4 * Real.pi * t ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h := ((((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (4*Real.pi)).log hp).const_mul
    (-((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)/2))).exp
  apply h.congr_deriv
  simp only [heatNormalization, id_eq, mul_one]
  field_simp

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_eq_gaussianRegularization
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_eq_gaussianRegularization {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    heatConvolution f t x = gaussianRegularization (4*t)⁻¹ f x
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 4*Real.pi*t := by positivity
  have he : Real.pi / (4*t)⁻¹ = 4*Real.pi*t := by
    rw [div_inv_eq_mul]
    ring
  simp only [heatConvolution, heatNormalization, gaussianRegularization, he,
    Real.rpow_def_of_pos hp, div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg]
  rw [mul_comm]
  congr 2
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_heatConvolution
statement:
theorem integral_heatConvolution {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : ∫ x, heatConvolution f t x = ∫ x, f x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [heatConvolution_eq_gaussianRegularization ht]
  exact integral_gaussianRegularization hf (by positivity)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_integrable
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_integrable {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : Integrable (heatConvolution f t)
proof:
:=
  (gaussianConvolution_integrable hf (by positivity : 0 < (4*t)⁻¹)).const_mul _

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_continuous
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_continuous {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : Continuous (heatConvolution f t)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.mul (gaussianConvolution_continuous hf (by positivity : 0 < (4*t)⁻¹))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_pos
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_pos {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)

:=

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_hasFDerivAt {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (heatConvolution f t) (innerSL ℝ (heatConvolutionGradient f t x)) x
proof:
:= by
  change HasFDerivAt (fun y => heatNormalization (E := E) t * gaussianConvolution (4*t)⁻¹ f y)
    (innerSL ℝ (heatNormalization (E := E) t • gaussianConvolutionGradient (4*t)⁻¹ f x)) x
  rw [map_smul]
  exact
    (gaussianConvolution_hasFDerivAt hf (by positivity : 0 < (4*t)⁻¹) x).const_mul
      (heatNormalization (E := E) t)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolutionGradient_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem heatConvolutionGradient_hasFDerivAt {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (heatConvolutionGradient f t) (heatConvolutionHessian f t x) x
proof:
:=
  (gaussianConvolutionGradient_hasFDerivAt hf (by positivity : 0 < (4*t)⁻¹) x).fun_const_smul _

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.heatConvolution_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem heatConvolution_hasDerivAt {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => heatConvolution f s x)
      (LinearMap.trace ℝ E (heatConvolutionHessian f t x).toLinearMap) t
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < (4*t)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hi := ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul 4).inv (by positivity : 4*t ≠ 0)
  have hc := (gaussianConvolution_hasDerivAt_width hf hb x).comp t hi
  apply ((heatNormalization_hasDerivAt (E := E) ht).mul hc).congr_deriv
  simp only [heatConvolutionHessian, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul,
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul, trace_gaussianConvolutionHessian hf hb x,
    Function.comp_apply, Pi.inv_apply, id_eq, mul_one]
  field_simp
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.lintegral_ofReal_le_of_ae_tendsto
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_le_of_ae_tendsto {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {u : ℕ → α → ℝ} {f : α → ℝ} {C : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ n, Integrable (u n) μ) (hu0 : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ u n x)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∫ x, u n x ∂μ ≤ C n)
    (hC : Tendsto C atTop (𝓝 c))
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => u n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c
proof:
:= by
  have hl : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, liminf (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (u n x)) atTop = ENNReal.ofReal (f x) :=
    hlim.mono fun x hx => ((ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp hx).liminf_eq
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ x, liminf (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (u n x)) atTop ∂μ :=
      lintegral_congr_ae (hl.mono fun x hx => hx.symm)
    _ ≤ liminf (fun n => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (u n x) ∂μ) atTop :=
      lintegral_liminf_le' (fun n => (hu n).aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal)
    _ ≤ liminf (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (C n)) atTop := by
      exact liminf_le_liminf (Eventually.of_forall fun n => by
        rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hu n) (Eventually.of_forall (hu0 n))]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbound n))
    _ = _ := ((ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp hC).liminf_eq

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_integrable
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_integrable
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i)) (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i)
proof:
:= by
  choose g hgc hgcompact hg0 hgae hgmass using
    fun i => exists_nonneg_compact_approximation (hf i) (hf0 i)
  have hi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => ∏ i, (g i n (D.map i x))^D.weight i) :=
    D.integrable_prod_continuous_compact (fun i => hgc i n) (fun i => hgcompact i n) (fun i => hg0 i n)
  have hnonneg (n : ℕ) (x : E) : 0 ≤ ∏ i, (g i n (D.map i x))^D.weight i :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hg0 i n _) _
  have hmass : Tendsto (fun n => ∏ i, (∫ y, g i n y)^D.weight i) atTop
      (𝓝 (∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i)) :=
    tendsto_finsetProd _ fun i _ => (hgmass i).rpow_const (Or.inr (D.weight_nonneg i))
  apply lintegral_ofReal_le_of_ae_tendsto hi hnonneg
    (fun n => D.integral_prod_le_continuous_compact
      (fun i => hgc i n) (fun i => hgcompact i n) (fun i => hg0 i n)) hmass
  have hp (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ x : E, Tendsto (fun n => g i n (D.map i x)) atTop (𝓝 (f i (D.map i x))) :=
    (D.map_quasiMeasurePreserving i).ae (hgae i)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hp] with x hx
  exact tendsto_finsetProd _ fun i _ => (hx i).rpow_const (Or.inr (D.weight_nonneg i))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.aestronglyMeasurable_prod_of_integrable
statement:
theorem aestronglyMeasurable_prod_of_integrable (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_fun_prod
  intro i _
  exact (Real.continuous_rpow_const (D.weight_nonneg i)).comp_aestronglyMeasurable
    ((hf i).aestronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving (D.map_quasiMeasurePreserving i))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integrable_prod_of_integrable
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_of_integrable (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i))
    (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) :
    Integrable (fun x => ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 (x : E) : 0 ≤ ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 i _) _
  apply (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable (D.aestronglyMeasurable_prod_of_integrable hf)
    (Eventually.of_forall h0)).mp
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (D.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_integrable hf hf0)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_prod_le_integrable
statement:
theorem integral_prod_le_integrable (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i))
    (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) :
    (∫ x, ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i) ≤ ∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i
proof:
:= by
  have hi := D.integrable_prod_of_integrable hf hf0
  have h0 (x : E) : 0 ≤ ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 i _) _
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg (hf0 i)) _
  have h := D.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_integrable hf hf0
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (Eventually.of_forall h0)] at h
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hb0).mp h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.lintegral_prod_le_integrable
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod_le_integrable (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i))
    (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) :
    (∫⁻ x, ∏ i, (ENNReal.ofReal (f i (D.map i x)))^D.weight i) ≤
      ∏ i, (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (f i y))^D.weight i
proof:
:= by
  have hp (x : E) : ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i) =
      ∏ i, (ENNReal.ofReal (f i (D.map i x)))^D.weight i := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 i _) _)]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ =>
      (ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hf0 i _) (D.weight_nonneg i)).symm
  have hm : ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i) =
      ∏ i, (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (f i y))^D.weight i := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg (hf0 i)) _)]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (hf0 i)) (D.weight_nonneg i),
      ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hf i) (Eventually.of_forall (hf0 i))]
  simpa only [hp, hm] using D.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_integrable hf hf0

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integrable_smul_bounded_kernel
statement:
theorem integrable_smul_bounded_kernel {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ)
    {g : E → G} (hg : Continuous g) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ C) (x : E) :
    Integrable (fun z => f z • g (x - z)) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (hf.norm.mul_const C).mono'
    (hf.aestronglyMeasurable.smul (hg.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    change ‖f z • g (x-z)‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ * C
    simpa only [norm_smul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC (x-z)) (norm_nonneg (f z))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.hasFDerivAt_convolution_of_bounded_kernel
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_convolution_of_bounded_kernel {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ)
    {g : E → G} {g' : E → E →L[ℝ] G}
    (hg : Continuous g) (hg' : Continuous g')
    (hd : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt g (g' y) y)
    {C C' : ℝ} (hC : ∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ C) (hC' : ∀ y, ‖g' y‖ ≤ C') (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∫ z, f z • g (y - z) ∂μ)
      (∫ z, f z • g' (x - z) ∂μ) x
proof:
:= by
  apply hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (F' := fun y z => f z • g' (y-z)) (s := univ) (bound := fun z => ‖f z‖ * C')
    (Filter.univ_mem)
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun y =>
      (integrable_smul_bounded_kernel hf hg hC y).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact integrable_smul_bounded_kernel hf hg hC x
  · exact (integrable_smul_bounded_kernel hf hg' hC' x).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z y _ => by
      simpa only [norm_smul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC' (y-z)) (norm_nonneg (f z))
  · exact hf.norm.mul_const C'
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z y _ => by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id, Function.comp_apply, id_eq] using
        ((hd (y-z)).comp y ((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) y).sub_const z)).fun_const_smul (f z)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.compactPerturbation_continuous

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.compactPerturbation_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem compactPerturbation_hasCompactSupport {f : E → ℝ} (hf : HasCompactSupport f) (e : ℝ) :
    HasCompactSupport (compactPerturbation f e)
proof: := hf.add unitTent_hasCompactSupport.mul_left

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_compactPerturbation
statement:
theorem integral_compactPerturbation {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) (e : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, compactPerturbation f e x) = (∫ x, f x)+e*(∫ x : E, unitTent x)
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ x, f x+e*unitTent x) = _
  rw [integral_add hf (unitTent_integrable.const_mul e), integral_const_mul]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.le_compactPerturbation
statement:
theorem le_compactPerturbation (f : E → ℝ) {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (x : E) :

proof: := le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg he (unitTent_nonneg x))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.integral_compactPerturbation_pos
statement:
theorem integral_compactPerturbation_pos {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e) :
    0 < ∫ x, compactPerturbation f e x
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_compactPerturbation hf]
  exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (integral_nonneg hf0) (mul_pos he unitTent_integral_pos)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.real_lintegral_prod_le_of_norm_sq
statement:
theorem real_lintegral_prod_le_of_norm_sq

    (hB : ∀ i, ‖B i‖ = 1)

  (Datum.ofNormSq B c hc (fun i => scalar_coisometry_of_norm_one (B i) (hB i))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.complex_lintegral_prod_le_of_norm_sq

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.operatorTrace_apply

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.norm_trace_le

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.scoreDerivative_continuous
statement:
theorem scoreDerivative_continuous (t : ℝ) (hH : ∀ i, Continuous ((U i).hessian t)) :
    Continuous (D.scoreDerivative U t)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun x => ∑ i, D.weight i • (D.map i).adjoint.comp (((U i).hessian t (D.map i x)).comp (D.map i)))
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  exact (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : E => D.weight i)).smul ((((hH i).comp (D.map i).continuous).clm_comp_const
    (D.map i)).const_clm_comp (D.map i).adjoint)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.timeRate_continuous
statement:
theorem timeRate_continuous {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hH : ∀ i, Continuous ((U i).hessian t)) :
    Continuous (D.timeRate U t)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun x => ∑ i, D.weight i * (LinearMap.trace ℝ (F i) ((U i).hessian t (D.map i x)).toLinearMap + ‖(U i).gradient t (D.map i x)‖^2))
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  have hg : Continuous ((U i).gradient t) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => ((U i).gradient_deriv t ht y).continuousAt
  have htr := (operatorTrace (E := F i)).continuous.comp ((hH i).comp (D.map i).continuous)
  change Continuous (fun x => operatorTrace ((U i).hessian t (D.map i x))) at htr
  simp_rw [operatorTrace_apply] at htr
  exact continuous_const.mul (htr.add (((hg.comp (D.map i).continuous).norm).pow 2))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.fluxDerivative_continuous
statement:
theorem fluxDerivative_continuous {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hH : ∀ i, Continuous ((U i).hessian t)) :
    Continuous (D.fluxDerivative U t)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := D.heatProduct_continuous U ht
  have hS := D.score_continuous U ht
  have hT := ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ E E).continuous.comp
    (hQ.smul ((innerSL ℝ).continuous.comp hS))).clm_apply hS
  exact hT.add (hQ.smul (D.scoreDerivative_continuous U t hH))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.iSup_ennreal_rpow_of_monotone
statement:
theorem iSup_ennreal_rpow_of_monotone (u : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hu : Monotone u)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (⨆ n, (u n)^c) = (⨆ n, u n)^c
proof:
:=
  iSup_eq_of_tendsto (fun _ _ h => ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hu h) hc)
    ((tendsto_atTop_iSup hu).ennrpow_const c)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.prod_iSup_ennreal_of_monotone
statement:
theorem prod_iSup_ennreal_of_monotone {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (u : ι → ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hu : ∀ i, Monotone (u i)) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, ⨆ n, u i n) = ⨆ n, ∏ i ∈ s, u i n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_insert ha, ih, ENNReal.iSup_mul, ENNReal.mul_iSup]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply iSup_le
      intro m
      apply iSup_le
      intro n
      apply le_iSup_of_le (max m n)
      exact mul_le_mul' (hu a (le_max_right m n))
        (Finset.prod_le_prod' fun i _ => hu i (le_max_left m n))
    · apply iSup_le
      intro n
      exact le_iSup_of_le n (le_iSup_of_le n le_rfl)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledConvolution_integrand_norm_le
statement:
theorem rescaledConvolution_integrand_norm_le (f : E → ℝ) (e : ℝ) (x z : E) :
    ‖f z*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x-e • z‖^2)‖ ≤ ‖f z‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (Real.exp _), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  have hk : Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x-e • z‖^2) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x-e • z‖])
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk (norm_nonneg (f z))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledConvolution_integrand_integrable
statement:
theorem rescaledConvolution_integrand_integrable {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    (e : ℝ) (x : E) : Integrable (fun z => f z*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x-e • z‖^2))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : E => Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x-e • z‖^2)) := by fun_prop
  exact hf.norm.mono' (hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hc.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (Eventually.of_forall (rescaledConvolution_integrand_norm_le f e x))

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledConvolution_continuous
statement:
theorem rescaledConvolution_continuous {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => rescaledConvolution f p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro p
  apply continuousAt_of_dominated (bound := fun z => ‖f z‖)
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun q =>
      (rescaledConvolution_integrand_integrable hf q.1 q.2).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun q =>
      Eventually.of_forall (rescaledConvolution_integrand_norm_le f q.1 q.2)
  · exact hf.norm
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by fun_prop

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledHeat_continuous
statement:
theorem rescaledHeat_continuous {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => rescaledHeat f p.1 p.2)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.mul (rescaledConvolution_continuous hf)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledConvolution_pos
statement:
theorem rescaledConvolution_pos {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (hmass : 0 < ∫ z, f z) (e : ℝ) (x : E) : 0 < rescaledConvolution f e x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Function.support (fun z => f z*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x-e • z‖^2)) = Function.support f := by
    ext z
    simp only [Function.mem_support, mul_ne_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨And.left, fun hz => ⟨hz, (Real.exp_pos _).ne'⟩⟩
  rw [rescaledConvolution, integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg
    (fun z => mul_nonneg (hf0 z) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (rescaledConvolution_integrand_integrable hf e x), hs]
  exact (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg hf0 hf).mp hmass

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledHeat_pos
statement:
theorem rescaledHeat_pos {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (hmass : 0 < ∫ z, f z) (e : ℝ) (x : E) : 0 < rescaledHeat f e x
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (rescaledConvolution_pos hf hf0 hmass e x)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledHeat_zero
statement:
theorem rescaledHeat_zero (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    rescaledHeat f 0 x = heatNormalization (E := E) 1*(∫ z, f z)*Real.exp (-(1/4 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rescaledHeat, rescaledConvolution, zero_smul, sub_zero, integral_mul_const]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledHeat_log_zero
statement:
theorem rescaledHeat_log_zero {f : E → ℝ} (hmass : 0 < ∫ z, f z) (x : E) :
    Real.log (rescaledHeat f 0 x) =
      -((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)/2)*Real.log (4*Real.pi) + Real.log (∫ z, f z) - (1/4 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [rescaledHeat_zero, heatNormalization,
    Real.log_mul (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hmass).ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne',
    Real.log_mul (Real.exp_pos _).ne' hmass.ne']
  simp only [mul_one, Real.log_exp]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.rescaledHeat_log_le
statement:
theorem rescaledHeat_log_le {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (hmass : 0 < ∫ z, f z) {R : ℝ} (hsupport : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R)
    {e : ℝ} (he : |e| ≤ 1) (x : E) :
    Real.log (rescaledHeat f e x) ≤ convolutionLogAmplitude f R 1 - (1/8 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  have hg : rescaledConvolution f e x ≤
      (∫ z, f z)*(Real.exp ((1/4 : ℝ)*R^2)*Real.exp (-(1/8 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2)) := by
    rw [rescaledConvolution, ← integral_mul_const]
    apply integral_mono (rescaledConvolution_integrand_integrable hf e x) (hf.mul_const _)
    intro z
    by_cases hz : f z = 0
    · simp only [hz, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · have hcentre : ‖e • z‖ ≤ R := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc
          |e| * ‖z‖ ≤ 1 * ‖z‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (norm_nonneg z)
          _ = ‖z‖ := one_mul _
          _ ≤ R := hsupport z hz
      have h := gaussian_shift_le_uniform x (e • z) hcentre (by norm_num : 0 ≤ (1/4 : ℝ))
      norm_num only [show (1/4 : ℝ)/2 = 1/8 by norm_num] at h
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (hf0 z)
  have hu : rescaledHeat f e x ≤ Real.exp (convolutionLogAmplitude f R 1 - (1/8 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ heatNormalization (E := E) 1*((∫ z, f z)*
          (Real.exp ((1/4 : ℝ)*R^2)*Real.exp (-(1/8 : ℝ)*‖x‖^2))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [convolutionLogAmplitude, heatNormalization, mul_one,
          sub_eq_add_neg, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hmass, neg_mul]
        norm_num
        ring
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log (rescaledHeat_pos hf hf0 hmass e x) hu

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.convolutionLogAmplitude_continuousAt
statement:
theorem convolutionLogAmplitude_continuousAt (f : E → ℝ) (R : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ContinuousAt (convolutionLogAmplitude f R) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold convolutionLogAmplitude
  fun_prop (disch := positivity)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.convolutionLogHeatFlow_logValue_le
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : heatConvolution f t x ≤
      Real.exp (convolutionLogAmplitude f R t - ((4*t)⁻¹/2)*‖x‖^2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ heatNormalization (E := E) t * ((∫ z, f z)*
          (Real.exp ((4*t)⁻¹*R^2)*Real.exp (-((4*t)⁻¹/2)*‖x‖^2))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussianConvolution_le_of_support_bound hf hf0 hsupport
          (by positivity : 0 < (4*t)⁻¹) x) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [convolutionLogAmplitude, heatNormalization, sub_eq_add_neg, Real.exp_add,
          Real.exp_log hmass, neg_mul]
        ring
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (heatConvolution_pos hf hf0 hmass ht x) hupper
  change Real.log (heatConvolution f t x) ≤ _
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using hlog

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.heatProduct_le_of_logValue_le
statement:
theorem heatProduct_le_of_logValue_le (t : ℝ) (a : ι → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hlog : ∀ i y, (U i).logValue t y ≤ a i-b*‖y‖^2) (x : E) :
    D.heatProduct U t x ≤ Real.exp (∑ i, D.weight i*a i)*Real.exp (-b*‖x‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, D.weight i*(a i-b*‖D.map i x‖^2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlog i _) (D.weight_nonneg i)
    _ = (∑ i, D.weight i*a i) - b*(∑ i, D.weight i*‖D.map i x‖^2) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [D.sum_weight_norm_sq]; ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.logarithmicHessian_trace
statement:
theorem logarithmicHessian_trace (v : ℝ) (g : E) (H : E →L[ℝ] E) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E (logarithmicHessian v g H).toLinearMap + ‖v⁻¹ • g‖ ^ 2 =
      LinearMap.trace ℝ E H.toLinearMap / v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [logarithmicHessian, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_sub,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [show ((innerSL ℝ g).smulRight g).toLinearMap =
    (innerSL ℝ g).toLinearMap.smulRight g from rfl]
  rw [LinearMap.trace_smulRight, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_innerSL_apply,
    innerₛₗ_apply_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.hasFDerivAt_logarithmicGradient
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_logarithmicGradient {u : E → ℝ} {g : E → E}
    {H : E →L[ℝ] E} {x : E} (hu : u x ≠ 0)
    (hd : HasFDerivAt u (innerSL ℝ (g x)) x) (hg : HasFDerivAt g H x) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => (u y)⁻¹ • g y) (logarithmicHessian (u x) (g x) H) x
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (hasDerivAt_inv hu).comp_hasFDerivAt x hd
  apply (hi.fun_smul hg).congr_fderiv
  ext y
  simp only [logarithmicHessian, add_apply, sub_apply, smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, smul_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  simp only [inv_pow, neg_mul]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.logProduct_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem logProduct_hasFDerivAt {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (D.logProduct U t) (innerSL ℝ (D.score U t x)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasFDerivAt (D.logProduct U t)
      (∑ i, D.weight i • (innerSL ℝ ((U i).gradient t (D.map i x))).comp (D.map i)) x :=
    HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun i _ =>
      (((U i).space_deriv t ht (D.map i x)).comp x (D.map i).hasFDerivAt).const_mul (D.weight i)
  have he : (innerSL ℝ (D.score U t x)) =
      ∑ i, D.weight i • (innerSL ℝ ((U i).gradient t (D.map i x))).comp (D.map i) := by
    ext z
    simp only [score, innerSL_apply_apply, D.synthesis_inner, sum_apply,
      smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]

      ((U i).gradient_deriv t ht (D.map i x))).comp x (D.map i).hasFDerivAt).const_smul _

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.trace_scoreDerivative
statement:
theorem trace_scoreDerivative (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E (D.scoreDerivative U t x).toLinearMap =
      ∑ i, D.weight i * LinearMap.trace ℝ (F i) ((U i).hessian t (D.map i x)).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  simp only [scoreDerivative, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_sum,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, D.trace_lift]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.trace_fluxDerivative
statement:
theorem trace_fluxDerivative (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ E (D.fluxDerivative U t x).toLinearMap =
      D.heatProduct U t x * (‖D.score U t x‖ ^ 2 +
        ∑ i, D.weight i * LinearMap.trace ℝ (F i) ((U i).hessian t (D.map i x)).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.norm_scalar_source
statement: theorem norm_scalar_source (A : 𝕜 →L[𝕜] E) : ‖A‖ = ‖A 1‖
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply A.opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg _)
    intro z
    calc
      ‖A z‖ = ‖A (z • (1 : 𝕜))‖ := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      _ = ‖z‖ * ‖A 1‖ := by rw [map_smul, norm_smul]
      _ ≤ ‖A 1‖ * ‖z‖ := le_of_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  · simpa only [norm_one, mul_one] using A.le_opNorm (1 : 𝕜)

proof:
:= by
  have hunit : ‖B.adjoint 1‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_scalar_source, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map, hB]
  have hiso : ∀ z : 𝕜, ‖B.adjoint z‖ = ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    calc
      ‖B.adjoint z‖ = ‖B.adjoint (z • (1 : 𝕜))‖ := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      _ = ‖z‖ := by rw [map_smul, norm_smul, hunit, mul_one]
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_adjoint, ContinuousLinearMap.one_def] using
    B.adjoint.norm_map_iff_adjoint_comp_self.mp hiso

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.lintegral_ofReal_le_of_pointwise_tendsto
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_le_of_pointwise_tendsto {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {u : ℕ → α → ℝ} {f : α → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ n, Integrable (u n) μ) (hu0 : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ u n x)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∫ x, u n x ∂μ ≤ C)
    (hlim : ∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => u n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C
proof:
:= by
  have hl (x : α) : liminf (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (u n x)) atTop = ENNReal.ofReal (f x) :=
    ((ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp (hlim x)).liminf_eq
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ x, liminf (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (u n x)) atTop ∂μ := by simp_rw [hl]
    _ ≤ liminf (fun n => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (u n x) ∂μ) atTop :=
      lintegral_liminf_le' (fun n => (hu n).aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal)
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C := by
      have hb : ∀ n, (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (u n x) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C := by
        intro n
        rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hu n) (Eventually.of_forall (hu0 n))]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbound n)
      simpa only [liminf_const] using liminf_le_liminf (f := atTop) (Eventually.of_forall hb)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_of_bounded_support
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_prod_le_of_bounded_support
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i)) (hfc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
    (hf0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y) (hmass : ∀ i, 0 < ∫ y, f i y)
    {C R : ι → ℝ} (hbound : ∀ i y, ‖f i y‖ ≤ C i)
    (hsupport : ∀ i y, f i y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R i) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (∫ y, f i y)^D.weight i)
proof:
:= by
  let τ := fun n : ℕ => 1/((n : ℝ)+1)
  have ht (n : ℕ) : 0 < τ n := by dsimp [τ]; positivity
  have hτ : Tendsto τ atTop (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat, Eventually.of_forall ht⟩
  let u := fun n x => ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) (τ n) (D.map i x))^D.weight i
  have hi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (u n) := by
    have h := (D.convolution_heatIntegrability hf hf0 hmass hsupport).product_integrable (τ n) (ht n)
    change Integrable (fun x => D.heatProduct
      (fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)) (τ n) x) at h
    simpa only [D.heatProduct_convolution_eq_prod hf hf0 hmass (ht n)] using h
  have hnonneg (n : ℕ) (x : E) : 0 ≤ u n x :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg
      (heatConvolution_pos (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i) (ht n) _).le _
  apply lintegral_ofReal_le_of_pointwise_tendsto hi hnonneg
    (fun n => D.integral_prod_heatConvolution_le hf hf0 hmass hsupport (ht n))
  intro x
  apply tendsto_finsetProd
  intro i _
  exact ((heatConvolution_tendsto_zero (hfc i) (hbound i) (D.map i x)).comp hτ).rpow_const
    (Or.inr (D.weight_nonneg i))

  have h0 (x : E) : 0 ≤ ∏ i, (f i (D.map i x))^D.weight i :=

  apply (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable hc.aestronglyMeasurable

    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hmass i).le (D.weight_nonneg i),

proof:
:= by
  let U := fun i => convolutionLogHeatFlow (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i)
  have ha (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (i : ι) : 0 ≤ convolutionGrowthCoefficient (R i) t :=
    convolutionGrowthCoefficient_nonneg (R i) ht
  have hg (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (i : ι) (y : F i) :
      ‖(U i).gradient t y‖^2 ≤ convolutionGrowthCoefficient (R i) t*(1+‖y‖^2) :=
    convolutionLogHeatFlow_gradient_sq_le (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i) (hsupport i) ht y

      ‖(U i).hessian t y‖ ≤ convolutionGrowthCoefficient (R i) t*(1+‖y‖^2) :=

    (fun t => (4*t)⁻¹/2) (D.convolutionProductGrowth R)
  · intro t ht
    positivity
  · exact fun t ht => D.growthCoefficient_nonneg (ha t ht)
  · exact fun _ ht => D.convolutionAmplitude_continuousAt f R ht
  · intro t ht

  · exact fun _ ht => D.convolutionProductGrowth_continuousAt R ht
  · exact fun _ ht i => convolutionLogHeatFlow_hessian_continuous (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i) ht
  · intro t ht x
    exact D.heatProduct_le_of_logValue_le U t
      (fun i => convolutionLogAmplitude (f i) (R i) t) ((4*t)⁻¹/2)
      (fun i y => convolutionLogHeatFlow_logValue_le (hf i) (hf0 i) (hmass i) (hsupport i) ht y) x
  · exact fun t ht x => D.score_sq_le_of_growth U t (ha t ht) (hg t ht) x

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.gaussianKernel_widthDerivative_norm_le
statement:
theorem gaussianKernel_widthDerivative_norm_le {b a : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b ≤ a) (x : E) :
    ‖-‖x‖ ^ 2 * gaussianKernel a x‖ ≤ 1 + 2 / (b / 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : gaussianKernel a x ≤ gaussianKernel b x := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hba (sq_nonneg ‖x‖)]
  have hp := norm_pow_mul_gaussianKernel_le 2 hb x
  norm_num only [Nat.factorial, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_mul] at hp
  calc
    _ = ‖x‖ ^ 2 * gaussianKernel a x := by
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg,
        abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), gaussianKernel, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 * gaussianKernel b x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ _ := hp

theorem gaussianConvolution_hasDerivAt_width {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : E) :
    HasDerivAt (fun a => gaussianConvolution a f x) (gaussianConvolutionWidthDerivative b f x) b
proof:
:= by
  apply (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (F := fun a z => f z * gaussianKernel a (x-z))
    (F' := fun a z => f z * (-‖x-z‖ ^ 2 * gaussianKernel a (x-z)))
    (s := Ioi (b/2)) (bound := fun z => ‖f z‖ * (1 + 2 / ((b/2)/2) ^ 2))
    (Ioi_mem_nhds (by linarith : b/2 < b)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).2
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun a => hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      ((gaussianKernel_continuous a).comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact gaussianConvolution_integrand_integrable hf hb x
  · exact (gaussianConvolutionWidthDerivative_integrand_integrable hf hb x).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z a ha => by
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (gaussianKernel_widthDerivative_norm_le (half_pos hb) ha.le (x-z)) (norm_nonneg _)
  · exact hf.norm.mul_const _
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z a _ => (gaussianKernel_hasDerivAt a (x-z)).const_mul (f z)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.le_quadratic_of_sq_le
statement:
theorem le_quadratic_of_sq_le {v K r : ℝ} (h : v^2 ≤ K*(1+r^2)) :
    v ≤ (1+K)*(1+r^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ≤ 1+v^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v-1)]
  have hr : 1+K*(1+r^2) ≤ (1+K)*(1+r^2) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
  exact hv.trans ((add_le_add le_rfl h).trans hr)

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.mul_le_polynomial_gaussian
statement:
theorem mul_le_polynomial_gaussian {q v A K b r : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hqa : q ≤ A*Real.exp (-b*r^2)) (hv : v ≤ K*(1+r^2)) :
    q*v ≤ (A*K)*(1+r^2)*Real.exp (-b*r^2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ q*(K*(1+r^2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv hq
    _ ≤ (A*Real.exp (-b*r^2))*(K*(1+r^2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqa (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.heatIntegrability_of_gaussian_bounds
statement:
theorem heatIntegrability_of_gaussian_bounds (A b K : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 < b t) (hK : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ K t)
    (hAcont : ∀ t, 0 < t → ContinuousAt A t)
    (hbcont : ∀ t, 0 < t → ContinuousAt b t)
    (hKcont : ∀ t, 0 < t → ContinuousAt K t)
    (hH : ∀ t, 0 < t → ∀ i, Continuous ((U i).hessian t))
    (hQ : ∀ t, 0 < t → ∀ x, D.heatProduct U t x ≤ A t*Real.exp (-b t*‖x‖^2))
    (hS : ∀ t, 0 < t → ∀ x, ‖D.score U t x‖^2 ≤ K t*(1+‖x‖^2))
    (hDS : ∀ t, 0 < t → ∀ x, ‖D.scoreDerivative U t x‖ ≤ K t*(1+‖x‖^2))
    (hT : ∀ t, 0 < t → ∀ x, ‖D.timeRate U t x‖ ≤ K t*(1+‖x‖^2)) :
    D.HeatIntegrability U
proof:
:= by
  have htime (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (x : E) :
      ‖D.heatProduct U t x*D.timeRate U t x‖ ≤
        (A t*K t)*(1+‖x‖^2)*Real.exp (-b t*‖x‖^2) := by
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (D.heatProduct U t x), abs_of_pos (D.heatProduct_pos U t x)]
    exact mul_le_polynomial_gaussian (D.heatProduct_pos U t x).le (hK t ht) (hQ t ht x) (hT t ht x)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    apply ((integrable_gaussian (E := E) (hb t ht)).const_mul (A t)).mono'
      (D.heatProduct_continuous U ht).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (D.heatProduct_pos U t x)]
      exact hQ t ht x
  · intro t ht
    apply integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound
      ((D.heatProduct_continuous U ht).mul (D.timeRate_continuous U ht (hH t ht))).aestronglyMeasurable
      0 2 (A t*K t) (hb t ht)
    simpa only [sub_zero, Pi.mul_apply] using htime t ht
  · intro t ht
    apply integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound
      ((D.heatProduct_continuous U ht).smul (D.score_continuous U ht)).aestronglyMeasurable
      0 2 (A t*(1+K t)) (hb t ht)
    intro x
    change ‖D.heatProduct U t x • D.score U t x‖ ≤ _
    simp only [sub_zero, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (D.heatProduct_pos U t x)]
    have hs := le_quadratic_of_sq_le (hS t ht x)
    have hk := hK t ht
    exact mul_le_polynomial_gaussian (D.heatProduct_pos U t x).le (by positivity) (hQ t ht x) hs
  · intro t ht
    apply integrable_of_polynomial_gaussian_bound
      (D.fluxDerivative_continuous U ht (hH t ht)).aestronglyMeasurable
      0 2 (A t*(2*K t)) (hb t ht)
    intro x
    simp only [sub_zero]
    apply (D.norm_fluxDerivative_le U t x).trans
    apply mul_le_polynomial_gaussian (D.heatProduct_pos U t x).le
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hK t ht)) (hQ t ht x)
    have hs := hS t ht x
    have hd := hDS t ht x
    linarith
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVpos, g, hg, hbound⟩ := exists_local_quadratic_gaussian_bound
      (0 : E) ht (hb t ht) ((hAcont t ht).mul (hKcont t ht)) (hbcont t ht)
      (P := fun _ => 1) (R := fun _ => 1) continuousAt_const continuousAt_const
    refine ⟨V, hV, hVpos, g, hg, fun s hs x => ?_⟩
    apply (htime s (hVpos hs) x).trans
    have h := hbound s hs x
    simp only [sub_zero, one_mul, Pi.mul_apply] at h
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans h

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_prod_heatConvolution_tendsto_sq_atTop
statement:
theorem integral_prod_heatConvolution_tendsto_sq_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => ∫ x, ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) (a^2) (D.map i x))^D.weight i)
      atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, (∫ z, f i z)^D.weight i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (D.tendsto_integral_rescaledProduct_zero hf hf0 hmass hsupport).comp
    (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => a⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0))
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with a ha
  exact (D.integral_prod_heatConvolution_eq_rescaled hf hf0 hmass ha).symm

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_prod_heatConvolution_tendsto_atTop
statement:
theorem integral_prod_heatConvolution_tendsto_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun t => ∫ x, ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) t (D.map i x))^D.weight i)
      atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, (∫ z, f i z)^D.weight i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (D.integral_prod_heatConvolution_tendsto_sq_atTop hf hf0 hmass hsupport).comp
    Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
  change (∫ x, ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) ((Real.sqrt t)^2) (D.map i x))^D.weight i) = _
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt ht]

name: GeometricBrascampLieb.Datum.integral_prod_heatConvolution_le
statement:
theorem integral_prod_heatConvolution_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ x, ∏ i, (heatConvolution (f i) t (D.map i x))^D.weight i) ≤
      ∏ i, (∫ z, f i z)^D.weight i
proof:
:= by
  apply ge_of_tendsto (D.integral_prod_heatConvolution_tendsto_atTop hf hf0 hmass hsupport)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop t] with s hs
  exact D.integral_prod_heatConvolution_monotoneOn hf hf0 hmass hsupport ht (ht.trans_le hs) hs
